projects.title: Autonomous Rover
projects.summary: A four-wheel rover that maps a small room and navigates around obstacles using an ultrasonic sensor array and a custom motor driver board.

subsections.title: Chassis design
subsections.description: Designed the frame in Fusion 360 and printed it in PETG for durability. Iterated through three versions to fix wheel clearance issues.

subsections.title: Motor driver board
subsections.description: Designed a custom PCB with dual H-bridge motor drivers, routed in KiCad, and hand-soldered the first prototype.

subsections.title: Path planning
subsections.description: Implemented an A* search algorithm in C++ on an Arduino Mega to plan routes around detected obstacles in real time.

projects.title: Single-Axis Solar Tracker
projects.summary: A small solar panel mount that rotates to follow the sun across the day, improving energy capture over a fixed panel.

subsections.title: Slew mechanism
subsections.description: Designed a worm-gear drive to rotate the panel mount slowly and hold position without back-driving from wind load.

subsections.title: Light sensing circuit
subsections.description: Built a comparator circuit from two photoresistors to detect which direction has more sunlight.

subsections.title: Control logic
subsections.description: Wrote the firmware that reads the sensor circuit and drives the stepper motor to track the sun throughout the day.

subsections.title: Mount bracket
subsections.description: Printed a PLA bracket to hold the photoresistor pair at a fixed angle relative to the panel.
